parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create one clean game sprite: a single fluffy white cumulus cloud, wide horizontal silhouette, exactly one object centered in a landscape 2:1 image.
Genuine transparent background. Leave a wide transparent margin on all four sides. No scenery, no cast shadow, no sun or rain.
Handmade 2D pixel art: several rounded overlapping puffs, crisp square stepped edges, limited palette of opaque ivory-white and light neutral gray only. Uniform medium pixel size, large simple pixel clusters, flat discrete interior shading, no outlines and no texture.
The outer silhouette is clean solid pixel steps. The surrounding transparent area is perfectly empty. No particles, no speckles, no separate fragments, no thin colored edge, no blue or cyan, no feathering, no glow, no gradients, no noise, no dithering, no text. A simple clean production sprite for use over green farm terrain, not a scene.

parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent cloud sprite for a pixel-art farm game; a brand-new image, NOT an edit of the landscape.
Primary request: Draw exactly ONE complete fluffy horizontal white cloud, centered with generous transparent padding on every side, approximately twice as wide as tall. The cloud is a unified group of round cumulus lobes with a gently uneven flat-ish underside, clear readable silhouette, and no detached cloud fragments.
Style/medium: true hand-placed-looking pixel art matching the reference farm landscape's crisp visible square pixel clusters, stair-stepped contours, broad discrete shading and calm game-art simplicity. No smooth brush rendering or photorealistic detail.
Color palette: white and a few very pale cool grays only, soft subdued shading INSIDE the cloud; no dark outline.
Composition/framing: landscape 2:1 canvas; cloud itself occupies at most 84 percent width and 76 percent height. Entire cloud must stay inside canvas.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background.
Constraints: one cloud only. No ground, landscape, sky, sun, rain, shadow beneath the cloud, glow, text, border, watermarks, or grid. Pixel silhouettes and internal pixel shading, no blur. Preserve full cloud edges and transparent padding.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Direct image review found cyan/blue fringe specks around the cloud.

parameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent pixel-art cloud sprite, revision of the newly generated cloud only.
Input image: existing cloud sprite, edit target.
Primary request: CLEAN THE OUTSIDE EDGE ONLY. Preserve the single fluffy horizontal cloud shape, its pixel-art style, pale white/cool-gray internal shading, size, position and transparent padding. Remove EVERY isolated stray fleck, noisy fringe, cyan/blue/green/red colored speck, crumb and pixel outside the connected cloud silhouette. The finished cloud has a clean continuous crisp stair-stepped pixel outline; everything outside that outline is fully transparent alpha.
The cloud must contain only white and very pale neutral/cool-gray pixels; absolutely no colored edge artifacts, no glow, no external drop shadow, no noisy dithering or semi-transparent feathering around the cloud. Do not redraw the cloud interior, add objects, change the cloud proportion, crop, or introduce any background. Exactly one complete cloud with clean transparent surrounding space.
